messages:
Jamie (sales): Heads-up — NovaPay sent a redlined DPA + vendor SIG. Main asks: add SCCs, explicit DSAR SLA (30 days), retention 90→180 days, customer key management, and confirmation on ephemeral cache behavior. Also asking for POC throughput headroom. Who can triage?

Ravi (solutions): I can take a first pass. Can you paste the redline or key callouts? Any high-risk asks called out by their security team?

Jamie (sales): Pasting snippets below. They also requested CAIQ v4 attestation + SCCs mapping. They want option for customer-managed keys for encryption-at-rest. Pricing note: want reserved throughput for 6 weeks during POC.

Devin (security): Quick answers up front: we have a SOC2 report and can provide a CAIQ response. SCC mapping exists but legal needs to approve DPA changes. Hosted API does NOT support CMK today — only Dedicated/Private do. For caching: prefix/KV cache is enabled by default but can be disabled per-tenant on Dedicated. @Marta please advise on DPA redlines.

Marta (privacy): SCCs via DPA addendum is our usual route. DSAR SLA — they want 15 business days, we usually commit to 30 calendar days. Also need to clarify deletion semantics (logical vs permanent). If they require 15 business days we need legal sign-off.

Alex (eng): On ephemeral KV cache: runtime TTL is 2h by default. For Dedicated we can expose a flag 'no_kv_cache=true' or set ttl=0 for the tenant. For hosted, we can implement request-side redaction to avoid caching PII. We can prototype a per-tenant flag for the POC.

Jamie (sales): They also want audit logs retained 180 days with user-id + request-id. Good to call out?

Devin (security): Default request logs retention is 90 days. We can offer 180 days as an enterprise retention add-on (security sign-off required). Logs are encrypted at rest using cloud KMS; we can produce an encryption diagram and key lifecycle note.

Ravi (solutions): POC pricing ask: reserved throughput and relaxed rate limits for 6 weeks. Recommend: offer Dedicated small pool with 30% off + free ingress/outbound for the POC window. Approvals?

Jamie (sales): @Carmen (pricing) can we approve a 30% off pricing path? Customer prefers a 40% number.

Carmen (pricing): We can approve up to 30% discount without RevOps. 40% needs RevOps + Finance signoff. Suggest 30% + extended telemetry (no extra cost) as counter. Also we need explicit acceptance criteria for POC.

Marta (privacy): Legal wants DPA redline to read: 'We will respond to DSARs within 30 days subject to identity verification; exportable dataset provided upon request.' They asked whether exported dataset will include request/response pairs — security note: we must pseudonymize user identifiers on export.

Alex (eng): Export format: we can generate CSV/NDJSON with request metadata + response text. Pseudonymization: we can hash user ids and optionally redact tokens flagged as PII. For POC I can write a small script that runs on export to pseudonymize.

Jamie (sales): Action items: 1) Devin — provide SCC mapping + SOC2 redacted by EOD tomorrow; 2) Alex — scope 'no_kv_cache' flag for tenant + export pseudonymize script; 3) Carmen — confirm pricing offer and draft POC terms; 4) Marta — draft DPA addendum with 30-day DSAR and supplementary measures. Target: reply to NovaPay by EOD tomorrow. :clock1:  

Devin (security): I'll upload SCC mapping doc and SOC2 redacted to the secure link by EOD and note any gaps. Also will list supplementary measures for transfers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New build queued: infra/retention-config -> staging (feature flag: tenant_cache_control). ETA ~2h.

Ravi (solutions): Thanks — I'll sync with the customer and capture acceptance criteria for the POC (throughput targets, sample prompts, success metrics). Also they asked about 'supplementary measures' for SCCs — @Marta will that be covered?

Marta (privacy): We have a standard supplementary measures appendix (encryption, access controls, logging). I'll attach it and note cross-border caveat for logs in US. Will draft the DPA addendum and supplementary measures attachment.

Jamie (sales): Perfect. I'll prep the reply to NovaPay after we have the docs. If we can fast-track the short Dedicated pool for POC that will help close. Thanks everyone.
